title: NHM Canonical Sample Schema V1
description: Canonical single-sample record under HARDWARE_DATA_CONTRACT_V1 (status DRAFT_FOR_G1_VERIFICATION, spec_version 2.2). This describes the target project interface, not a claim that current hardware/backend already emits this shape. The OBSERVED_MONGODB_SCHEMA_V0 document does not satisfy this schema; see docs/OBSERVED_MONGODB_SCHEMA_V0.md and the compatibility table in contracts/HARDWARE_DATA_CONTRACT_V1.md. Missing modalities are represented by explicit null/validity fields, never by magic numeric sentinels (0, 1024, 2048, -1 carry no assumed meaning under this contract).

participant_id.description: Pseudonymous participant identifier. Demographics must never be inferred from it.

session_id.description: Unique identifier for one acquisition session.

timestamp_us.description: Device/session time: microseconds since device session start (int64 semantics). Used for ordering, synchronization, window boundaries, and gap detection. Not a wall-clock claim.

sample_index.description: Monotonically increasing source sample index within the session.

ecg_raw.description: Raw ECG ADC counts from the AD8232 acquisition path. Not millivolts; calibrated ECG requires a separately versioned field. null means the modality is explicitly unavailable for this sample, not a sentinel value.

ppg_red_raw.description: Raw MAX30102 red-channel ADC counts. null when unavailable.

ppg_ir_raw.description: Raw MAX30102 infrared-channel ADC counts. null when unavailable.

spo2_pct.description: Derived SpO2 percentage. Never laboratory ground truth. null when spo2_valid is false or the modality is unavailable.

spo2_valid.description: Explicit validity flag for spo2_pct; required even when spo2_pct is null.

hr_ecg_bpm.description: Heart rate derived from ECG. Kept separate from pr_ppg_bpm; disagreement between the two is never silently collapsed.

pr_ppg_bpm.description: Pulse rate derived from PPG. Kept separate from hr_ecg_bpm.

ecg_quality.description: ECG channel quality state. UNUSABLE suppresses physiological alerting and yields RECHECK_SENSOR at the application layer.

ppg_quality.description: PPG channel quality state, or null when no PPG modality is present for this sample at all.

source.description: Provenance identifier for the sample origin (e.g. a dataset id or live acquisition path identifier). Not itself a claim of physiological validity.

preprocess_version.description: Identifier of the causal preprocessing transform applied, or null for an unprocessed raw sample. PREPROC_V1 is not implemented as of T003; this field only reserves the identifier slot.
